steps: What really happened during the wedding in the diary? And is there really a ghost?
The talisman flew into a house that had clearly been through a fire. The smoke-blackened walls and charred furniture say it all.
The air in the house has this lingering burnt smell. I'm not sure if it's from the talisman or just our imagination.
This village really is full of dolls everywhere...
I've heard that even though dolls look human, they don't have souls—so they're easy targets for wandering spirits and ghosts to possess...
But there are so many dolls here...
Ahem, let's just...==W== Hey, what are you even digging around for? This place is clearly empty, nothing to investigate. Let's just get out of here.
Weren't you the one who said to trust you? Since your talisman flew this way, we should at least check it out.
A notebook...? Something's written in it.
"Floris Month, Honeysuckle Day. Rain... I made plans to go into the city with him. It's the first time he's ever invited me."

==A1==Chixia and I flip through the charred diary.==P== ==A2==Some of the writing has faded from age and water damage. However, from the legible parts, we are able to piece together a bit of the writer's past.==P== ==A2==The diary belongs to a young girl. It tells the story of how she met a Loong man, how they got to know each other and eventually fell in love. You could feel her happiness and hope for the future in every word.==P== ==A-2==On the final page of the diary, it says that tomorrow was the big day; her mother made her a red ceremonial dress for the traditional Loong wedding.
It's such a happy story, but it ends right before the wedding day.==W== Could it be... Something went wrong during the ceremony?
Hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==... ==W==When we got here, the whole village was dark, right?
Then... What's going on over here?
I look to where Chixia's finger is pointing and see a soft orange light glowing from a window in the dark.
A shadowy figure stands at the window. It looks like it's staring straight at us.
In the blink of an eye, the shadow in the window vanishes. That unsettling feeling of being watched is gone, too.
Aren't you a Xuan Shi?! Don't you want to go check out what's going on right now?!
No way! That's exactly how it goes in all the Monolith movies. Curiosity kills the cat; people who go looking for trouble end up dead!
Rock, paper, scissors. If you win, we head home right now.
Before I came out here, I gave my word to the Baize Bureau. I told them I'd brought in Chixia the Xuan Shi and that you'd definitely get the job done.
It's probably nothing. Maybe that shadow was just the curtain blowing in the wind.
You sure? That's exactly what people say right before they get themselves killed in those movies!
Keep it in your inner pocket. If things get dangerous, it might come in handy.
Wait—is this the legendary, super-useful protection talisman that every Trekker's gotta have?!
Absolutely! They say no matter how dangerous things get, if you've got a protection talisman from Chixia the Xuan Shi, it's basically like having an extra life.
Since your talisman is so powerful, what are you even worried about? Come on, let's go!
Hehe. Chixia the Xuan Shi will definitely get the job done...
Huh?! Hey! Boss!!==W== Slow down! Wait for me!
The room's empty, except for an old carved wooden table with a few red candles set on top.
I've got a bad feeling about this...==W== Hey, ==PLAYER_NAME==, you're just gonna walk in like that?!
Ugh, seriously, where do you even get that kind of courage? Mind sharing a little of it with me...?
Red silk ribbons hang from the beams and pillars of the rundown house, and a tattered "Double Happiness" symbol is still stuck to one of the broken windows.
Time's worn the vibrant red down to a dull gray, adding an eerie vibe to the place.
What's all this for? Some kind of ceremony?
It ...==W== looks like the traditional Loong wedding?
Oh right, the diary did mention a wedding... Could this be where the ceremony was supposed to take place?
It's possible.==W== But... Why are these candles still burning? Not to mention...
Why are these fruits on the table still so fresh?!
They look like they've just been picked.
But the wedding must have taken place a long time ago.
A horrible accident must have befallen the bride on the day of her wedding—that's why the diary ended there. She never made it to the ceremony, hence the lingering bitterness...
Ooh, nice deduction!==W== So her spirit's been lingering, and that's why the village is haunted?
Maybe those dolls are connected too—what if her fiancé made them to remember her?
A cold gust of wind blows through. The flickering candlelight stretches our shadows across the wall, making them look like they've come to life.
Chixia, are you okay? You look as pale as a...
I, I, I'm fine. I'm Chixia the Xuan, Xuan … Xuan Shi! I, I, I can do it!
Honestly, if you're this scared, we're better off leaving.
No, I'm fine! I, I can't embarrass Yunji and the profession of Xuan Shi.
Ahem... I've heard that if someone passes away with regrets, they can't move on to the afterlife. That means all we have to do is...
Fulfill her last wish? Recreate what happened that day?
Yes, yes!==W== Hmm, how did you know that?
Yeah … how did I know that? Sounds like the plot of a movie...
Anyway, I'm sure that'll work! Go me! Hehe.
If we're going to recreate what happened that day, how do we figure out exactly what she's holding onto?
Since she led us here, it must be...
There's no wind, so why did the candle just flicker...?
Uh... So that means if we finish the wedding she never got to have, ==W==she'll finally be at peace and able to move on...?
Ahhhhh! I knew it! There's a ghost here!!!!
